title: Nullpoint join the pro ranks
body:
[[Nullpoint]] are officially a pro team, playing under the tag 0PT.

They earned their place through BPL Challengers Stage 2026 champion.

**The roster.** [[candybar_isblue]] (#10), [[UtsuhoNull]] (#22), [[zhizyii]] (#109), [[Kaito_Oshino]] (#163) and [[ssseiso]] (#282).

The headline name is [[candybar_isblue]], currently #10 in the league. Their first ranking points will come at their next event.
